correctness.rationale: The overlap digraph has q constant triple vertices of degree q-1 and 3q(q-1) nonconstant vertices of degree two. Each unordered pair of alphabet symbols contributes a disjoint six-state internal block X to the directed Laplacian; its exact determinant is 28 and its Schur transfer is 1/7 [[3,4],[4,3]]. Eliminating all blocks leaves reduced Laplacian 4/7(qI-J), whose root-deleted determinant is (4/7)^{q-1}q^{q-2}; multiplying 28^{binom(q,2)} yields root tree count 2^{(q-1)(q+2)}7^{binom(q-1,2)}q^{q-2}. Every internal node lies on routes between constants, giving strong connectivity. BEST theorem with fixed unique initial 0001 edge multiplies by ((q-2)!)^q, with no further division. Independent direct graph and rational Schur calculation gave exact q=2,3,4 tree cofactors 16,21504,1438646272 and cycle counts 16,21504,23018340352. Finite checks corroborate exact symbolic all-q proof.
